verdict.rationale: Hightouch's sync engine runs on schedules or triggers with CDC that continuously detects added/changed/removed rows, and syncs 'in real-time or on a recurring schedule' to 300+ destinations including ad platforms and engagement tools, with a Lightning engine for high-frequency change detection. This directly supports continuous audience membership updates entering/exiting near-real-time. Missing for 10: explicit documented latency/SLA numbers for 'near-real-time' and independent hands-on confirmation of real-time membership churn behavior beyond vendor docs.
